panel.coordinate: carrier rank12 plus deterministic-sign balanced-SVD residual rank4

validity.member_identity: one global member for the complete trajectory
validity.initial: same-member fixed50 success on the exact init-state row
validity.probe_scope: The inherited bank contains antithetic-averaged responses; this pass calibrates that existing coordinate and does not qualify future distributional q_pi evidence.

supported: The inherited owner/flow/action coordinate consistently ranks all fifteen known-success balanced-SVD paths, including Goal and Long.
A single global member identity with conservative verified state masks preserves the same path signal without stage-wise member splicing.
The legacy objective also has a strictly decreasing route to every known-success endpoint, so absence of successful low-loss basins is not the explanation for the prior solver failures.
Balanced-SVD rank4 is the first authorized canonical coordinate for Phase 2B.
not_supported: A deployment-compatible realizer has been trained or passed closed loop.
Candidate or recovery member-state continuation validity is established.
q_pi, q_V, Program-to-effect, or video inference is implemented.
interpretation.trust_note: Some full endpoints exceed the historical 1.5 trust limit, but alpha=0.75 keeps even the largest endpoint below 1.29 trust while already lying late on every decreasing path. The old trust cap is therefore not the sole cause of solver failure.

next_action.authorized: Freeze deterministic-sign balanced-SVD residual coordinates, retain probe particles in successor evidence, add richer member-state validity, and train a small held-free target-local amortized realizer before q_pi.
not_authorized: q_pi training before the realizer gate
